analysis.title: Bitcoin Is Already Trading At Its 'Democratic Sweep' Price: Goldman Maps The Uptober Bust Into Election Night
key_insights: BTC finished October 2026 down 7.4% at $77,401, ETH fell 16.2% and SOL fell 19.3%. US-listed spot ETFs for all three had a combined $2.3 billion of outflows. Most of the decline came in the final week.

North Korea's TraderTraitor unit was blamed by TRM and Chainalysis for a roughly $6.3 billion Binance theft, and the FBI confirmed it. It is described as the largest crypto hack on record, versus about $1.5B for the Bybit hack. BTC hit a six-week low near $76,350.

Binance covered about 95% of affected tokens by Sunday, and Tether and Circle helped freeze roughly $3 billion of the stolen funds. GS's James Yaro noted $19.9B, or 14% of platform assets, left Binance after the disclosure. Total crypto market cap was down 4% from the day before the hack.

BTC spot ETFs took in $441M in the four sessions before the hack, then lost $643M on Friday alone. Spot ETF assets fell 8.4% to $98.2B. ETF flows swung from a $2.39B inflow in September to a $550M outflow in October. BTC was down 29% YoY.
ETH ETF demand was already weakening before the Binance breach, per GS's Kenny Lee, so its weaker demand extended beyond the immediate reaction to the breach.

ETH ended October at $2,252 against a realized price of $2,213, an MVRV of 1.02, so the average holder is near breakeven. BTC MVRV is 1.43 with a realized price of about $54,000. ETH ETF assets fell 19% to $13.2B, CME open interest is down 65% YoY, and trusted spot volumes fell 17%.

ETH supply active over the past year fell to roughly 34%, the lowest in the five-year window shown. 44.15M ETH is staked (up 23.6% YoY, about 36% of supply) at a yield near 3.3%. ETH burnt rose 72% MoM.

SOL fell 19.3% to $95.29, down 49% YoY and down 12.9% against BTC. SOL spot ETF AUM fell 23% to $1.4B on $144M of outflows. Spot and CME volumes fell 28.7%. Staking yield fell 20.6% YoY to 5.29% as the issuance cut is voted to accelerate from 15% to 30% a year.
Solana activated Alpenglow on October 21 to cut finality to a fraction of a second. Ethereum's Glamsterdam upgrade went to the Sepolia testnet, aimed at tripling baseline processing capacity.

Perp liquidations on Oct 29-30 were about $2B, BTC perp open interest fell only 0.55% against a 3.66% price drop, and annualized BTC funding stayed near 10%. GS's Lee reads this as bullish positioning that was not especially stretched going in, with perp traders adding exposure on the dip.
Miner revenue rose 8.9% MoM, and miner-to-exchange flows fell 6.6% MoM and are down 79% YoY. Exchange balances are about 2.65M BTC versus more than 3M in 2023-24.

The Senate blocked the CLARITY Act 49-50 on September 15, with every Democrat voting against starting debate. The sticking points were ethics language on the president's crypto income and stablecoin yield.

TD Cowen's Jaret Seiberg called a Democratic sweep the most negative scenario for crypto, with Warren taking the Senate Banking gavel and CLARITY effectively dead for two years. A split Congress is better for BTC, and a Republican sweep is the best path for crypto policy.

Seiberg also said Warren cannot stop regulators from adopting pro-industry policies, and Trump would veto bills limiting them. Bernstein and GS FX's Stuart Jenkins likewise see a narrow policy range because the President can rely on executive action.

Bloomberg's Markets Pulse survey of 301 professionals put the median year-end BTC call at $90,831 under a GOP sweep, $84,141 under a split Congress and $76,456 under a Democratic sweep. BTC closed October at $77,401, near the Democratic-sweep figure.

GS's equity sales team said a Democratic House looks largely priced, with prediction markets near 77%, and the Senate is the main source of surprise. The article's author says Democrats swept and cites Texas and Ohio losses for Republicans.

The author's view is that the blue wave is largely priced but the flush probably is not, especially if ETH's $2,213 cost basis breaks. The case rests on the missing ETF bid, ETH at cost basis and perp funding near 10% into a falling market.

BTC, ETH and SOL spot ETFs had a combined $2.3B of outflows. BTC ETF assets fell 8.4% to $98.2B and flows swung from a $2.39B September inflow to a $550M October outflow.
ETH trades at an MVRV of 1.02, with price $2,252 against a realized price of $2,213, while BTC MVRV is 1.43 with a realized price near $54,000.

SOL staking yield fell 20.6% YoY to 5.29% and the issuance cut is being accelerated from 15% to 30% a year. SOL ETF AUM fell 23% to $1.4B.
Perp liquidations of about $2B and a 0.55% decline in BTC perp open interest, with annualized funding near 10%, suggest leveraged longs added on the dip.

risk_factors: A break of ETH's $2,213 realized price could trigger further selling.
The BTC ETF bid has stopped, and outflows could continue.
A Democratic Senate could bring oversight of regulators and leave CLARITY dead for about two years.
Perp funding near 10% in a falling market points to long positioning that has not been flushed.
Further Binance outflows after the $19.9B that left following the hack disclosure.
A higher bar for future crypto regulation after the largest crypto hack on record.
vol_and_positioning: BTC perp liquidations on October 29-30 were about $2B, described by GS as notable but relatively contained.
BTC perp open interest fell 0.55% against a 3.66% price drop.

tension_points.bull_case: Weak hands are gone: miners are hoarding, ETH supply is dormant, leverage absorbed the largest hack, and a White House using executive action caps the regulatory downside. Bitcoin already trades near the $76,456 Democratic-sweep survey call.
tension_points.bear_case: The ETF bid has disappeared, ETH sits on its cost basis, a Democratic Senate means two years of oversight of friendly regulators, and perp funding near 10% into a falling market points to long positioning that has not been flushed.
tension_points.what_invalidates: ETH breaking below its $2,213 realized price would signal the flush has not finished.

theme_stances.key_argument: The ETF bid has gone missing, ETH is at its cost basis with no flow cushion, and long positioning has not been flushed.
